q: The entropy of a factor of an ergodic system satisfies:
opts: h(factor) ≤ h(T), with equality iff the factor is isomorphic to T
exp: Factors have smaller or equal entropy: if π: (X,T) → (Y,S) is a factor map, then h(S) ≤ h(T). Equality h(S) = h(T) holds iff π is an isomorphism (in the Bernoulli case—Ornstein's theorem implies this for Bernoulli shifts).
